import json

def parse_cli(raw):
    clean = raw.split('\n[stderr]\n', 1)[0].strip()
    # Remove trailing (.venv) prompt if present
    if clean.endswith('(.venv)'):
        clean = clean[:clean.rfind('(.venv)')].strip()
    return json.loads(clean)

p1 = parse_cli(prod1_raw)["result"]
p2 = parse_cli(prod2_raw)["result"]
p3 = parse_cli(prod3_raw)["result"]

def format_product(p):
    lines = []
    lines.append(f"Product ID:    {p.get('product_id', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"Name:          {p.get('name', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"Category:      {p.get('category', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"Price:         ${p.get('price', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"Rating:        {p.get('rating', 'N/A')} / 5")
    lines.append(f"In Stock:      {p.get('stock', 'N/A')} units")
    lines.append(f"Shipping Days: {p.get('shipping_days', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"Gift Wrap:     {'Yes' if p.get('gift_wrap_available') else 'No'}")
    desc = p.get('description', 'N/A')
    lines.append(f"Description:   {desc}")
    specs = p.get('specs', {})
    if specs:
        lines.append("Specs:")
        for k, v in specs.items():
            lines.append(f"  - {k}: {v}")
    compat = p.get('compatible_with', [])
    if compat:
        lines.append(f"Compatible With: {', '.join(compat)}")
    price_drop = p.get('price_drop')
    if price_drop:
        lines.append(f"Recent Price Drop: was ${price_drop.get('old_price')} → now ${price_drop.get('new_price')}")
    volume_discount = p.get('volume_discount')
    if volume_discount:
        lines.append(f"Volume Discount: {json.dumps(volume_discount)}")
    return '\n'.join(lines)
